title: Red Air 203
summary: A McDonnell Douglas MD-82 experienced a left main landing gear collapse during landing rollout at Miami International Airport on runway 09. The aircraft was descending normally when extreme vibrations developed on the left side immediately after left main gear touchdown. The failing shimmy damper allowed uncontrolled oscillations that fractured the lower torque link. The collapsed gear caused the aircraft to veer left, depart the runway, and strike a glide slope equipment shelter. The right main gear and nose gear subsequently collapsed. All 140 occupants evacuated safely with four minor injuries.
probable_cause: The left main landing gear shimmy damper failed to mitigate extreme vibrations during landing rollout. The vibrations caused the gear's lower torque link to fail and the entire left landing gear assembly to collapse. The collapsed gear caused the aircraft to veer left, depart the runway, and strike a glide slope equipment shelter. The right main gear and nose gear subsequently collapsed from the impact. (p. 1-2)

factors.evidence: Left main landing gear shimmy damper failed to mitigate extreme vibrations during landing rollout, causing lower torque link fracture (p. 1-2)
The shimmy damper design did not adequately mitigate vibrations experienced during this landing (p. 1)
Aircraft had high vertical speed or unusual vibrations at touchdown on left main gear (p. 1)
During landing rollout left main gear collapsed and airplane traveled to left departing the paved surface (p. 1-2)
Aircraft impacted runway 30 glide slope equipment shelter causing structural damage (p. 2)
Shortly after aircraft stopped post-crash fire began on right wing (p. 1)

events.text: Aircraft on final approach to Miami International Airport runway 09
Right main gear touched down first on runway 09 at Miami International Airport
Left main gear touched down slightly right of centerline; pilots experienced sensation of increase in vibration on left side
Extreme vibrations continued during landing rollout due to shimmy damper failure; aircraft vibrating violently (p. 1-2)
During landing rollout left main gear collapsed and airplane traveled to left departing paved surface (p. 1-2)
Airplane impacted runway 30 glide slope equipment shelter; right main gear and nosewheel also collapsed (p. 1-2)
Fuel tanks breached; shortly after airplane stopped post-crash fire began on right wing (p. 1)
All 140 occupants evacuated safely approximately 5 seconds after aircraft stopped
Emergency response personnel contained fire and secured scene
